tbesh_html:
1) to burst forth
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to burst forth
1a2) to draw forth
1a3) to bring forth
1b) (Hiphil) to break forth
Aramaic equivalent: gi.ach (גִּיחַ "to strive" H1519)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to gush forth (as water), generally to issue
strongs_1890.kjv_def: break forth, labor to bring forth, come forth, draw up, take out.
